title: Single-layer biosensor for urinary prostate-cancer biomarkers through transition-metal-doped graphene: a DFT study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42522-42532
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06085K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Joshua Zhou, Xuan Luo
Ag-doped graphene is identified by DFT as the most responsive single-layer sensor for urinary sarcosine, combining strong adsorption, clear band-gap tuning, and viable room-temperature recovery.
